subject: Re: Kickoff: batch-size science for our training fleet
body:
Status + one finding that changes the playbook.

Curves are done for all three workloads. The retrieval tower behaves like the paper's best cases: perfect scaling to batch 8k, ceiling around 32k. The ranker hits diminishing returns at 2k - much earlier than anyone assumed - and the LM fine-tune sits in between.

The finding: our production ranker has been training at batch 8k, which is 4x past its perfect-scaling regime. We're burning roughly 3x the accelerator-hours per unit of progress there. Fixing the batch/LR pair per the measured curve cuts the ranker's weekly training bill by an estimated 55-60%.

Risk for the playbook: the curves are optimizer-sensitive (the paper flags this too - momentum shifts the ceiling). Our recommendation tool needs to re-measure when teams change optimizers, or it will confidently give stale advice. Giannis is adding a staleness warning.

Kaia
